zh: 週一美股收低：標普 500 收 7,416.59 點、跌 1.92%；那斯達克收 24,509.76 點、跌 2.49%；道瓊收 51,608.17 點、跌 1.41%；羅素 2000 收 2,742.94 點、跌 1.70%。恐慌指數 VIX 升 18.7% 到 22.91。報導把原因歸給三件事：AI 與晶片股在 Nvidia 財報前降低持股、市場預期 12 月 Fed 升息（週內公布的生產者物價高於預期）、以及強勢美元。這是上週五小跌之後的第二個下跌日，波動明顯放大。
en: US stocks fell Monday: the S&P 500 closed at 7,416.59 (-1.92%), the Nasdaq at 24,509.76 (-2.49%), the Dow at 51,608.17 (-1.41%) and the Russell 2000 at 2,742.94 (-1.70%). The VIX jumped 18.7% to 22.91. Coverage points to three drivers: investors cutting AI and chip exposure ahead of Nvidia's results, expectations of a December Fed hike after hotter-than-expected producer prices, and a strong dollar. It follows a smaller drop last Friday, and volatility has clearly widened.

stocks.n: 標普 500 ETF，週一約 -1.9%
那斯達克 100 ETF，科技賣壓最重
道瓊 ETF，週一約 -1.4%

zh: Nvidia 週一收跌約 4%，報導說董事會並未考慮讓黃仁勳回任執行長，即使公開有川普的支持；財報就在週二盤後。晶片股同時承壓，因為美國收緊海外取得先進晶片的限制、目的是防止繞過對中國的管制。另外 Intel 跌近 6%，起因是一件股東集體訴訟，指控公司隱瞞個人電腦需求轉弱的影響。三件事都落在同一條線：AI 硬體的不確定性在財報前被一起定價。
en: Nvidia closed down about 4% Monday after reports that its board is not considering bringing Jensen Huang back as CEO despite public support from President Trump; results are due Tuesday after the close. Chip stocks were also weighed down by tighter US limits on overseas access to advanced chips, aimed at stopping circumvention of the China controls. Intel fell nearly 6% after a proposed shareholder class action alleging it hid the impact of weaker PC demand. All three sit on one line: AI-hardware uncertainty priced in together before the report.

stocks.n: 週一約 -4%，11/17 盤後財報
半導體 ETF，受出口管制消息拖累

zh: 跨資產方面：12 月原油期貨收 85.04 美元，跌 3.97%，布蘭特約 92 美元，原因是荷莫茲海峽的出貨持續恢復，儘管美國增加了中東軍力；10 年期美債殖利率 5.12%，小降 0.03 個百分點，仍在 5% 以上；黃金收 3,858.90 美元，跌 0.71%，有報導說金價碰到一年新低。油價回落有助通膨預期，但殖利率不降，股市估值壓力沒有解除。
en: Across assets: December crude closed at $85.04, down 3.97%, with Brent near $92, as Strait of Hormuz shipments kept recovering even as the US added forces in the Middle East; the 10-year Treasury yield was 5.12%, down 0.03 points but still above 5%; gold closed at $3,858.90, down 0.71%, and one report says it touched a one-year low. Lower oil helps inflation expectations, but with yields not falling the valuation pressure on equities is unchanged.

stocks.n: 原油基金，WTI 式期貨週一 -3.97%
黃金 ETF，金價約 3,859 美元
長天期美債 ETF，殖利率 5.12%

zh: 指數以外的三則大異動：Summit Therapeutics 收跌 12.69%，原因是 FDA 否決了它的 ivonescimab 二線肺癌申請；加拿大電信 TELUS 在多倫多漲超過 11%，起因是 Quebecor 提出 310 億加幣的現金加股票收購；美國主要銀行股約跌 2%，報導說與行動 App 當機有關。三件事互不相干，提醒今天的下跌不只是 AI 一條線，個股事件風險同時存在。
en: Three moves beyond the indexes: Summit Therapeutics closed down 12.69% after the FDA rejected its ivonescimab application for second-line lung cancer; Canadian telecom TELUS rose more than 11% in Toronto after Quebecor proposed a C$31 billion cash-and-stock takeover; and major US bank stocks fell about 2% on reports of app outages. The three are unrelated, a reminder that Monday's decline was not only the AI trade and that single-name event risk is present as well.

stocks.n: FDA 否決二線肺癌申請，單日 -12.69%
TELUS 美國掛牌，母市漲超過 11%
金融類 ETF，大型銀行約 -2%

zh: Tyson Foods 週一盤前公布會計年度第四季：調整後每股盈餘 0.61 美元，年減 47%；各家對共識的說法不一（0.59 到 0.75 美元不等），所以有媒體寫「略勝」、也有寫「落後」。牛肉部門調整後虧損 1.71 億美元（含 8,000 萬美元活牛存貨減損），全年牛肉虧損 6.54 億美元。股價卻漲約 9%，原因是 2027 財年指引：調整後營業利益 17 億到 21.5 億美元，牛肉由虧損 3 億到獲利 1 億美元，營收預估減 3.5% 到 5.5%。
en: Tyson Foods reported fiscal Q4 before Monday's open: adjusted EPS of $0.61, down 47%; sources differ on consensus ($0.59 to $0.75), so some outlets call it a slight beat and others a miss. Beef posted an adjusted loss of $171 million, including an $80 million non-cash cattle inventory write-down, and the full-year beef loss was $654 million. The stock still rose about 9% on fiscal 2027 guidance: adjusted operating income of $1.7-2.15 billion, beef between a $300 million loss and a $100 million profit, and sales down 3.5-5.5%.

stocks.n: Q4 調整後 EPS 0.61 美元；股價約 +9%
雞肉同業，可對照雞肉價格與利潤
肉品同業，可對照食品需求

zh: 美東週二盤前，Home Depot 與 Disney 公布財報（台灣時間週二晚上）。預期值：Home Depot 每股盈餘 3.84 美元（年增 2.7%）、營收 428 億美元（年增 3.4%）；Disney 每股盈餘約 1.68 美元、營收約 251.6 億美元。同一天 10 月零售銷售也出爐，預期月增 0.2%、扣除汽車 0.4%。Home Depot 看的是 5% 以上殖利率下的房屋相關消費；Disney 看串流獲利與樂園客流。這些是預期值，不是結果。
en: Before Tuesday's US open, Home Depot and Disney report (Tuesday evening in Taipei). Expectations: Home Depot EPS of $3.84 (+2.7%) on revenue of $42.8 billion (+3.4%); Disney EPS near $1.68 on revenue near $25.16 billion. October retail sales also land that day, expected +0.2% on the month and +0.4% excluding autos. Home Depot is a read on housing-related spending under a 10-year yield above 5%; Disney on streaming profit and park attendance. These are expectations, not results.

stocks.n: 週二盤前；預期 EPS 3.84 美元
週二盤前；預期 EPS 約 1.68 美元
週三盤前接著公布，可交叉對照

zh: Nvidia 週二盤後公布財報，市場預期每股盈餘 2.47 美元（年增約 90%）、營收 1,088 億美元（年增約 91%）。這是黃仁勳辭職後的第一份財報，由代理執行長 Colette Kress 主持說明會。報導引述的說法是：領導層變動不會影響本季與下一季的獲利，因為出貨大多已鎖定；但分析師已有下修評等或目標價的動作。另外 Nvidia 被報導將在 Anthropic 上市前以私募方式投入最多 100 億美元。
en: Nvidia reports Tuesday after the close; the market expects EPS of $2.47 (up about 90%) on revenue of $108.8 billion (up about 91%). It is the first report since Jensen Huang's exit, with interim CEO Colette Kress hosting the call. Coverage says the leadership change will not affect this quarter's or next quarter's earnings because sales are largely locked in, though analysts have downgraded or cut price targets. Nvidia is also reported to be putting up to $10 billion into a private placement ahead of the Anthropic IPO.

stocks.n: 週二盤後財報；預期 EPS 2.47 美元
AI 硬體同業，財報後的連動觀察
記憶體，AI 需求的另一個指標

zh: 市場對 12 月升息的押注沒有降溫：週一的報導把下跌原因之一寫成「生產者物價高於預期之後，預期 12 月 Fed 升息」。另一份報導引述 CME FedWatch，12 月再升息的機率約 85%，並說 Warsh 在最近一次表態中沒有承諾 12 月要升息。需要小心：各家對 Fed 目前的利率區間與是否已經升過息，說法互相矛盾，我以較可信的版本（維持 3.75% 至 4.00%、兩位官員投票主張升息）為準，細節請對 Fed 官網。
en: Rate-hike bets for December have not cooled: Monday's coverage lists expectations of a December Fed hike after hotter-than-expected producer prices among the reasons for the sell-off. Another report cites CME FedWatch at about 85% for another hike in December and says Warsh stopped short of committing to one at his latest remarks. Caution: sources contradict each other on the current policy range and whether a hike already happened; I use the more credible version (held at 3.75-4.00% with two officials voting for a hike), and the Fed's own site should settle it.

stocks.n: 中天期美債 ETF，對升息預期最敏感
區域銀行 ETF，利率與存款成本的觀察窗
美元指數基金，強勢美元是週一的壓力之一

zh: Fed 官網的行事曆列出：10 月 27 至 28 日 FOMC 會議的紀要，在週三（美東 11/18）下午 2 點公布。這次的重點不是利率決定（已知維持 3.75% 至 4.00%），而是兩位主張升息的官員有多少人跟進、紀要怎麼描述「12 月再升一次」的條件，以及對 5% 以上長天期殖利率的看法。紀要是會後三週才公布的舊資訊，市場通常只挑語氣變化看，不用把它當新決定。
en: The Fed's calendar lists the minutes of the October 27-28 FOMC meeting for release Wednesday (November 18 US time) at 2:00 p.m. The focus is not the rate decision, already known as a hold at 3.75-4.00%, but how many officials beyond the two who voted for a hike were leaning that way, how the minutes describe the conditions for a December move, and how they treat long yields above 5%. The minutes are three-week-old information, so the market usually reads only changes in tone, not a new decision.

stocks.n: 公用事業 ETF，高殖利率股對利率最敏感
房地產 ETF，同樣受長天期殖利率影響

zh: 兩個政策面消息同時影響週一的盤面。第一，美國收緊海外取得先進晶片的限制，目的是防止有人繞過對中國的管制，報導說這壓抑了半導體股。第二，荷莫茲海峽的出貨持續恢復，使原油期貨跌近 4%，但美國同時增加中東軍力，風險並沒有消失，只是被價格暫時消化。政策風險不像財報有日期，通常以突發公告形式出現，所以板塊內的個股表現會被拉開。
en: Two policy items shaped Monday. First, the US tightened limits on overseas access to advanced chips, aimed at stopping anyone circumventing the China controls, which coverage says weighed on semiconductors. Second, shipments through the Strait of Hormuz kept recovering, pushing crude futures down almost 4%, yet the US also added forces in the Middle East, so the risk has not gone, only been priced for now. Unlike earnings, policy risk has no calendar and arrives as sudden announcements, which widens the gap between names within a sector.

stocks.n: 半導體 ETF，出口管制消息的直接受壓者
原油基金，海峽出貨恢復拉低油價

zh: AI 這條線本週有三個事件排在一起：週二盤後 Nvidia 財報、週三 Anthropic 定價、週四在那斯達克以代號 ANT 開始交易。報導寫的條件是 8.25 億股、每股 70 到 78 美元，對應市值 1.3 兆到 1.45 兆美元，低於先前傳的最高 2 兆。市場的邏輯是：新的大型 AI 供給進場，會分走既有 AI 持股的資金，所以週一的賣壓有一部分是提前調整部位。上市後的表現才是真正的訊號。
en: Three AI events are lined up this week: Nvidia's results Tuesday after the close, Anthropic's pricing Wednesday, and first trading Thursday on Nasdaq under the ticker ANT. Reported terms are 825 million shares at $70-78, an implied value of $1.3-1.45 trillion, below the earlier talk of up to $2 trillion. The market logic is that a large new AI supply draws money away from existing AI holdings, so part of Monday's selling was positioning ahead of time. The post-listing trading is the real signal.

stocks.n: 報導之外的背景：Anthropic 的主要投資方之一
同為 Anthropic 的投資方之一，週內關注
科技權重 ETF，可看資金是否被分流

zh: 能源板塊週一跟著油價走弱：12 月原油期貨跌 3.97% 到 85.04 美元。有意思的是內部人動作：HF Sinclair（DINO）執行長 Franklin Myers 以每股 110.80 美元買進 1 萬股，約 110.8 萬美元，持股增至 207,723 股；該股一個月跌約 20%，離 10 月中的高點 129.37 美元已有距離。需要注意：公司約 90% 的調整後 EBITDA 來自煉油景氣，景氣一轉就會反映在獲利上。
en: Energy followed oil lower Monday: December crude fell 3.97% to $85.04. The insider action is more interesting: HF Sinclair (DINO) CEO Franklin Myers bought 10,000 shares at $110.80, about $1.108 million, lifting his holding to 207,723 shares; the stock is down about 20% in a month from a mid-October high of $129.37. Caution: roughly 90% of its adjusted EBITDA comes from the refining cycle, so a turn in the cycle shows up directly in earnings.

stocks.n: 能源 ETF，隨油價回落
HF Sinclair；執行長近期買進約 110.8 萬美元

zh: 生技板塊週一被 FDA 的決定拉開差距：Summit Therapeutics 在 FDA 否決 ivonescimab 的二線肺癌申請後收跌 12.69%，市場爭論點一直是 FDA 要不要求整體存活期有統計顯著性。這類個案讓小型生技股的風險變得很清楚：單一藥物、單一審查結果就能決定股價。資金面上，生技要在 5% 以上殖利率的環境籌資，通常要付出折價，這點在小型股風雲頻道另有一例。
en: Biotech split on an FDA decision Monday: Summit Therapeutics closed down 12.69% after the FDA rejected its ivonescimab application for second-line lung cancer, with the long-running dispute being whether the FDA requires statistically significant overall survival. Cases like this show the risk in small biotech: a single drug and a single review can decide the share price. On financing, biotech raising money with yields above 5% usually pays a discount; the small-cap channel has an example.

stocks.n: FDA 否決後單日 -12.69%
生技 ETF，板塊風險溫度計

zh: 羅素 2000 週一收 2,742.94 點，跌 1.70%（47.55 點），比標普 500 的 1.92% 跌幅略小。本月 11 月 5 日該指數盤中曾跌 2.5%，當時的說法也是利率與通膨擔憂。小型股的一個結構特性是對債券殖利率特別敏感，原因是它們的負債較多、浮動利率借款比例較高；殖利率停在 5.12% 時，這類壓力不會自行消失。短線看，12 月升息的預期有沒有被紀要強化，比個別財報更重要。
en: The Russell 2000 closed Monday at 2,742.94, down 1.70% (47.55 points), a little less than the S&P 500's 1.92%. On November 5 it fell as much as 2.5% intraday, also on rate and inflation worries. A structural trait of small caps is high sensitivity to bond yields because of heavier debt and more floating-rate borrowing; with the 10-year at 5.12% that pressure does not fade on its own. In the short run whether the minutes reinforce December hike expectations matters more than any single earnings report.

stocks.n: 小型股 ETF，另一種小型股取樣

zh: TTM Technologies（TTMI，印刷電路板、市值超過 70 億美元，屬中型股）10 月 22 日單日大跌約 30%，報導列出的疑慮是供應鏈瓶頸與靠舉債進行的併購。11 月 5 日一位董事買進 1 萬股，約 63.2 萬美元，持股增至 45,835 股，增幅約 28%。一個月累計跌幅約 50%。這屬於大跌之後內部人進場的類型，但金額對公司規模來說不大，要看後續是否有第二位內部人跟進與下一次財報的訂單。
en: TTM Technologies (TTMI, printed circuit boards, market value above $7 billion, a mid cap) fell about 30% in one session on October 22, with worries listed as supply-chain bottlenecks and debt-funded acquisitions. On November 5 a director bought 10,000 shares, about $632,000, lifting his holding to 45,835 shares, a roughly 28% increase. The one-month decline is about 50%. It is a post-crash insider purchase, but the size is small relative to the company; watch for a second insider and the next report's orders.

zh: Rapport Therapeutics（RAPP，神經科學生技）10 月底以每股 21 美元募資 3.5 億美元、約 1.75 億股，比前一日價格折價約 24%，同時第二期躁症試驗相對安慰劑只領先 3.1 分，且退出與激躁比率較高；一個月股價跌約 23.5%。有意思的是一位董事 10 月 28 日也以約 21 美元買進 96.9 萬股，約 2,036 萬美元，持股增至 281.6 萬股。融資折價與內部人加碼同時出現：前者是公司要現金，後者是個人押注。
en: Rapport Therapeutics (RAPP, neuroscience biotech) raised $350 million at $21 a share in late October, about 175 million shares at roughly a 24% discount, as Phase 2 bipolar mania data showed only a 3.1-point edge over placebo with higher discontinuation and agitation rates; the shares fell about 23.5% in a month. Interestingly a director also bought 969,480 shares at about $21 on October 28, roughly $20.36 million, lifting his holding to 2.82 million shares. A discounted raise and insider buying at the same price: one is the company needing cash, the other a personal bet.

stocks.n: 募資折價約 24%；董事買進約 2,036 萬美元

zh: 小型股的一個判讀角度是「債務與放空比例」。同一份名單裡，Applied Digital（APLD）債務約 64 億美元、放空比例 23.90%，一個月跌 38.7%；Galaxy Digital（GLXY）放空比例 20.64%，一個月跌 40.6%，擔憂是債務與未出租的資料中心容量。放空比例高代表賣方也押注，內部人買進因此不能直接當成底部訊號：兩邊都在用真錢投票，看的是誰的時間表更接近下一個財報。
en: One lens for small caps is debt and short interest. In the same list Applied Digital (APLD) carries about $6.4 billion of debt with 23.90% short interest and fell 38.7% in a month; Galaxy Digital (GLXY) has 20.64% short interest and fell 40.6%, with worries over debt and unleased data-center capacity. High short interest means sellers are also betting, so insider buying cannot be read as a bottom signal: both sides are voting with real money, and what matters is whose timeline is closer to the next report.

stocks.n: 債務約 64 億美元，放空比例 23.90%
放空比例 20.64%，一個月跌 40.6%

zh: 本週財報除了 Nvidia 與大型零售，還有一批中型股值得看。週二：Klarna（先買後付）。週四：Ross Stores、Williams-Sonoma、Gap、Bath & Body Works。週五：BJ's Wholesale Club。這些公司的共同點是客群偏美國中等收入家庭，對高房貸利率與消費信心很敏感，剛好可以和 Home Depot、Target、Walmart 的結果交叉對照。11 月密西根消費者信心終值預期為 53.3，數字本身就偏低。
en: Beyond Nvidia and the big retailers, a group of mid caps report this week: Tuesday, Klarna (buy now, pay later); Thursday, Ross Stores, Williams-Sonoma, Gap and Bath & Body Works; Friday, BJ's Wholesale Club. They share a customer base of middle-income US households that is sensitive to high mortgage rates and consumer confidence, so they cross-check the Home Depot, Target and Walmart results. The final November Michigan sentiment reading is expected at 53.3, already a low number.

stocks.n: 週二財報，先買後付
週四財報，家居零售
週四財報，消費品
週五財報，會員制量販

zh: Lantronix（LTRX，池內，工業物聯網與無人系統模組）11/9 公布 2027 財年第一季：營收 3,240 萬美元、年增 8.6%；嵌入式物聯網營收年增 37% 到 1,570 萬美元，來自無人機與無人系統需求；非 GAAP 毛利率 45.3%，非 GAAP 淨利 220 萬美元（年增 50%）；現金與有價證券 5,150 萬美元。公司維持全年雙位數營收成長，並指引第二季營收 3,250 萬到 3,450 萬美元。風險：GAAP 每股盈餘未達預期、營運現金流為負 250 萬美元、展望只是重申，股價缺乏明確催化劑。這是研究線索，不是投資建議。
en: Lantronix (LTRX, in the pool; industrial IoT and unmanned-systems modules) reported fiscal Q1 2027 on 11/9: revenue of $32.4 million, up 8.6%; embedded IoT revenue up 37% to $15.7 million on drone and unmanned-systems demand; non-GAAP gross margin 45.3% and non-GAAP net income $2.2 million (+50%); cash and marketable securities $51.5 million. It kept double-digit full-year growth and guided Q2 revenue to $32.5-34.5 million. Risks: GAAP EPS missed, operating cash flow was negative $2.5 million, and the outlook was only reaffirmed, leaving no clear catalyst. This is a research lead, not investment advice.

zh: 同一份名單可以練習「金額」與「持股比例」兩個角度。Caterpillar（CAT）一位董事買進 1,000 股、約 62 萬美元，持股增加約 27%，但對一家股價 600 多美元的公司來說只是個人的小額表態；Galaxy 的 Novogratz 買進約 986 萬美元，但該股放空比例 20.64%、仍比 52 週低點高。比較好用的問法：買進金額佔這個人現有持股的比例、是不是多人同時買、買進價離近期低點有多遠。單筆買進不是訊號，叢集才是。
en: The same list lets you practice two angles, amount and share of holdings. A Caterpillar (CAT) director bought 1,000 shares, about $620,000, raising his holding about 27%, yet for a stock above $600 it is a small personal statement; Galaxy's Novogratz bought about $9.86 million, but short interest is 20.64% and the stock is still above its 52-week low. Better questions: what share of the person's existing holding the buy represents, whether several insiders bought together, and how far the price is from the recent low. A single buy is not a signal; a cluster is.

zh: 判讀這類資料有幾個前提。申報最多晚 45 天，所以看到的是舊價位；金額只有寬區間；許多是配偶或信託帳戶；筆數多不代表有 thesis。另外政策面有新消息：眾議院 7 月 22 日以 232 比 198 通過《停止內線交易法案》，禁止議員、配偶與受扶養子女買進個股，並要求賣出前 7 到 14 天通知；但參議院看來興趣不高，通過需要 60 票。禁令若成真，這個頻道的資料型態會改變。
en: Several premises apply when reading this data. Filings can be 45 days late, so prices are stale; amounts are wide ranges; many trades are by spouses or trusts; and a high count does not imply a thesis. There is also policy news: on July 22 the House passed the Stop Insider Trading Act 232 to 198, barring members, spouses and dependent children from buying individual stocks and requiring notice 7 to 14 days before selling; the Senate seems uninterested and would need 60 votes. If a ban became law, the data in this channel would change shape.

tag: 三天內的一串 AI 事件
zh: 最值得注意的一件事：週一的 1.92% 跌幅並不是單一消息，而是市場在三天內要同時消化一串 AI 事件：週二盤後 Nvidia 財報（首度沒有黃仁勳）、週三 Anthropic 定價與 FOMC 紀要、週四 Anthropic 開始交易，背景還有 5.12% 的 10 年期殖利率與 12 月升息預期。有一個值得先想的問題：如果 Nvidia 財報很好、股價卻仍下跌，那代表的是這家公司的問題，還是整個 AI 主題的資金被新供給分走了？
en: The one thing most worth noting: Monday's 1.92% drop was not one headline but the market having to absorb a chain of AI events in three days: Nvidia's results Tuesday (the first without Huang), Anthropic's pricing and the FOMC minutes Wednesday, and Anthropic's first trading Thursday, all against a 5.12% 10-year yield and December hike expectations. A question worth thinking about first: if Nvidia's results are strong and the stock still falls, is that about the company, or about money being drawn away from the whole AI theme by new supply?
